title: Dey Sarkar Residence
subtitle: Complete 3,000 sq.ft. Home Interior – Foyer, Living, Dining, Kitchen & Bedrooms
description: A complete 3,000 sq.ft. home interior in Balurghat, from a sculptural foyer with a water wall and vertical garden to formal and family living rooms, a prayer niche, dining, kitchen and three bedrooms, each with its own character within a warm palette of timber, marble, sage and soft neutrals.
body:
Designed for Bishu Dey Sarkar in Balurghat, this 3,000 sq.ft. residence is a complete home interior, covering the foyer, a ground-floor formal living room, an upstairs family living room, a prayer niche, dining, kitchen and three bedrooms.

The home opens with a statement foyer: a carved entrance door, a cast-stone water wall, a vertical garden and a timber arched portal that frames the view inside. From there, each space takes on its own character. The formal living room is soft and curved with a statement chandelier fan, while the family living room upstairs is warmer, with an upholstered panel wall, brass accents and a corridor leading to a calm, arched prayer niche.

Dining and kitchen are planned as a connected unit, with a slatted timber ceiling and mirror wall over the dining table, a fully equipped U-shaped kitchen and a lit crockery unit between them. The three bedrooms each have a distinct mood, from the master bedroom's sculptural relief wall and walnut ceiling, to a botanical mural with a built-in study, to a calm wave-line feature wall.

Recurring arches, warm timber, marble and layered lighting tie the whole home together into one cohesive design.
features.0.title: A Sculptural Arrival
features.0.text: The foyer sets the tone for the whole home. A carved entrance door with flowing relief work opens onto a cast-stone water wall, a full-height vertical garden and a timber-clad arched portal with layered LED-lit reveals. A pair of abstract sculptures on a blush plinth frames the view into the living room, with a herringbone timber ceiling strip running overhead.
features.1.title: Ground-Floor Formal Living
features.1.text: The formal living room is soft and curved. An ivory curved sofa sits against a textured damask wallpaper wall with a timber-framed window, under a statement chandelier fan with teal blades and glass rods. Brass pendants, marble side tables and a pill-shaped fluted glass niche with a floating timber console complete the room, with a topographic-pattern feature wall behind the floating TV console.
features.2.title: Family Living
features.2.text: Upstairs, the family living room is warmer and more relaxed. A blush upholstered panel wall with an arched channel pattern sits beside a white fluted strip and a brass disc sconce. A grey sofa, ivory swivel armchair, slatted coffee table and geometric rug are framed by arched doors with diagonal grooves and brass inlays, and a black metal screen with circular inlays.
features.3.title: A Quiet Prayer Niche
features.3.text: At the end of the corridor, an arched niche with sage fluted backing and a soft LED edge holds a seated Buddha on a curved white console. Sage arch-outline panels with backlit circles line the walls, turning a passage into a calm, contemplative corner.
features.4.title: Dining Under Timber Beams
features.4.text: A six-seat terrazzo-top dining table with rust upholstered chairs sits beneath a slatted timber ceiling. A grid mirror wall reflects the kitchen and doubles the sense of space, flanked by white fluted panels and glass-disc wall sconces.
features.5.title: A Fully Equipped Kitchen
features.5.text: The U-shaped kitchen combines matt taupe base units, handleless white uppers with walnut accents and glass-front cabinets. A quartz worktop runs into a full-height backsplash around the angled chimney and hob, with a central prep table, wicker pull-out baskets, a double wall oven and a side-by-side fridge tower. A tall crockery unit with bronze glass doors and lit shelves links the kitchen to the dining area.
features.6.title: The Master Bedroom
features.6.text: The master bedroom is anchored by a backlit sculptural relief wall set in a walnut surround. A textured white headboard wall with arched relief tiles, a channel-tufted grey headboard and a brass sconce sit under a walnut ceiling with a wave-profile cove. Sage wardrobes with walnut arch and pill-shaped inlays frame a lit, fluted bronze glass centre unit.
features.7.title: A Botanical Bedroom with Study
features.7.text: The second bedroom pairs a softly backlit botanical mural with sculpted white panels and star cut-outs, behind a green channel-tufted headboard. A built-in study with a curved floating desk and lit book shelves is set into the wardrobe wall.
features.8.title: A Calm, Flowing Third Bedroom
features.8.text: The third bedroom is quiet and minimal. A cove-lit wave line divides a taupe and white feature wall above a textured channel headboard and floating side tables, beside a full-height white shaker wardrobe with a fluted band.
highlights.0.title: Water Wall & Vertical Garden
highlights.0.text: A cast-stone water feature and living green wall greet guests at the entrance.
highlights.1.title: Every Room Designed
highlights.1.text: Foyer, two living rooms, prayer niche, dining, kitchen and three bedrooms in one scheme.
highlights.2.title: Signature Arches
highlights.2.text: Arched portals, doors, niches and inlays repeat throughout the home.
highlights.3.title: Statement Lighting
highlights.3.text: Chandelier fans, brass pendants, disc sconces and cove lighting in every space.
highlights.4.title: Rich Material Palette
highlights.4.text: Walnut, terrazzo, marble, fluted panels, brass and bronze glass.
highlights.5.title: Distinct Room Personalities
highlights.5.text: Each bedroom has its own mood, from sculptural relief to botanical mural to calm wave lines.
